column1: # Keys of the encrypted blocks of the virtual code (docs/pipeline.md).
# Written by scripts/devirt/find-block-keys.ps1: never by hand.
# method: token of the virtualized method. block: offset of the encrypted bytes in its body.
# key: the 32-bit value that decrypts the block. string: the text whose hash is the key (FNV-1a,
# the hash the compiler gives a 'switch' on a string); empty for a key found by search.
